method: Inspected all thirteen exhaustive full-execution atlas pages, all ten larger walking-detail pages, and the fixed-world/following-camera overview.
findings: Ground-resting original-sized box is physically acquired before free lift.
Actual robot translates across the fixed world grid and 2 m ruler during five complete alternating swing/replant events; this is not object-only displacement or stationary stepping.
The box remains airborne and retained throughout the entire measured walking interval.
Root motion and alternating foot placements agree with the independent world-coordinate trajectories.
Braking precedes controlled lowering; terrain weight transfer precedes opening.
Physical opening, whole-tool upward withdrawal, and stable final robot/object are visible.
rendering_note: Video is a state visualization of the complete rollout independently replayed exactly at every physics step. Ruler, grid and green root trail are rendering decorations only, absent from the physics model.
